notes: Working weights start empty. After each session, log actual loads, reps, and RPE, then update the matching working_weights entry. Add a personal_records object when a reported set is a best-to-date for that lift and rep range. Do not invent loads. preferred_start_date is Monday, November 30, 2026 in America/Phoenix so the weekly calendar lines up. Split: Mon quad squat, Tue upper push, Wed posterior hinge, Thu back/pull, Fri full lower and core. TrainHeroic history imported 2026-11-25 (729 logged sessions, 2022-01-03 to 2026-11-26). Use imported working weights as Week 1 starting references and adjust to the prescribed RPE.

trainheroic_import.note: Working weights and PRs come from logged TrainHeroic sets only. Lifts with no history were left empty. A more recent but much lighter session is noted and not used as the working weight.
